AuditOut.description: `actor_name`: the acting person's display name (None for other principals).
AuditOut.title: AuditOut

DiffOut.description:
Line by line from `from_number` to `to_number`; a changed line is a `delete`
followed by an `insert`.
DiffOut.title: DiffOut

DirectoryEntryOut.description: Who can be added to a space. Deliberately no email or role: any member may read it.
DirectoryEntryOut.title: DirectoryEntryOut

ExpectedVersion.description: The page version the client read (stale → 409 `page.version_conflict`).
ExpectedVersion.title: ExpectedVersion

GroupMemberIn.description: People only in M1; agents join in M6.
GroupMemberIn.title: GroupMemberIn

MeOut.description:
`permissions`: the system-wide actions the caller holds; clients decide what to
show from these (and from a space's `my_role`), never from the role's name.
MeOut.title: MeOut

PageMove.description:
`parent_id` null: the top level. `position` among the new siblings, 0 first;
left out: at the end, or where the page is if its parent stays.
PageMove.title: PageMove

PageOut.description:
`version` guards writes (send it back; stale → 409). `collab_generation` changes
whenever open live-editing sessions of the page end. `tags`: tag ids, by name.
PageOut.title: PageOut

PageUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are; neither may be null.
PageUpdate.title: PageUpdate

PasswordChangeIn.description: A person's own new password; the current one proves it is them.
PasswordChangeIn.title: PasswordChangeIn

SpaceCreate.description: `personal` is a valid kind but not one the API creates (422 spaces.kind_not_allowed).
SpaceCreate.title: SpaceCreate

SpaceMemberOut.description: `name`: the person's or group's display name.
SpaceMemberOut.title: SpaceMemberOut

SpaceOut.description: `my_role` is the caller's role there, for display (system admins: `admin`).
SpaceOut.title: SpaceOut

SpaceRole.description:
A role inside one space, ordered `viewer < editor < moderator < admin` (by rank,
not alphabetically, so `max()` gives the strongest).
SpaceRole.title: SpaceRole

SystemRole.description: A person's organisation-wide role. There is always at least one active owner.
SystemRole.title: SystemRole

TagCreate.description:
Without `space_id` a system-wide tag (`tag.manage`); with one, a tag of that
space (`page.moderate` there).
TagCreate.title: TagCreate

TagUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are; neither may be null. A tag keeps its scope.
TagUpdate.title: TagUpdate

TagsSet.description:
The object's tags from now on (the set replaces the old one); `version` is the
page version the client read.
TagsSet.title: TagsSet

TrashedPageOut.description:
A page that went into the trash on its own or with the pages below it; `path`
and `parent_id` are where it was.
TrashedPageOut.title: TrashedPageOut

TreeNodeOut.description:
A page in the flat tree: nest by `parent_id`, order siblings by `sort_order`.
`tags`: tag ids, by name.
TreeNodeOut.title: TreeNodeOut

UserUpdateIn.description: The PATCH body: the changes plus the version the client read.
UserUpdateIn.title: UserUpdateIn

VersionAuthor.description: `name` is None for an author that is not a person.
VersionAuthor.title: VersionAuthor

VersionSummaryOut.description:
`change_summary` is free text, or `restore:<n>` for a version that brought
version n back (the client words it).
VersionSummaryOut.title: VersionSummaryOut

post.description: The caller's own password; this session stays, every other one ends.

delete.description: Delete a page in the trash for good, with everything below it (system admins).

put.description: Replace the page's tags (`page.edit`); bumps the page version.

parameters.description: false: leave out other people's personal spaces
parameters.name: include_others_personal

schema.description: false: leave out other people's personal spaces
schema.title: Include Others Personal

parameters.description: only system-wide tags and this space's
parameters.name: space_id

schema.description: only system-wide tags and this space's
schema.title: Space Id

delete.description: Also takes the tag off everything that carries it.
